title: Ramsey House Visitor Center

services.name: Private Events
services.desc: Surrounded by 100 breathtaking acres, Historic Ramsey House is a stunning wedding venue that blends Southern charm with historic elegance. Completed in 1797, this beautifully preserved home provides a romantic and unforgettable backdrop for your celebration. Imagine exchanging vows beneath a canopy of century-old trees, dancing under the stars in a picturesque meadow, or celebrating with loved ones inside our charming event space. Whether you dream of an intimate gathering or a grand outdoor affair, our venue offers the flexibility to bring your vision to life. services.name: Field Trips
services.desc: Historic Ramsey House offers students a memorable, immersive educational experience they’ll cherish for years to come. Through engaging tours and interactive activities, students will step back in time to discover life in 1700s Tennessee, exploring the world of the Ramsey family and other residents of the property. They’ll also learn about the significant contributions these individuals made to the community. blurb: Built in 1797 of locally sourced pink marble and blue limestone, Ramsey House was indeed known as the “finest house in Tennessee”. Because of its architectural sophistication and relative opulence, Ramsey House welcomed many diplomats and important guests through its doors.
